I appreciate you reaching out, but I'm a coding assistant designed to help with software development tasks like reading files, writing code, running commands, and editing projects. I don't have access to your phone or its settings, so I can't directly help you turn off cellular service.

That said, here's some general guidance:

- **iPhone**: Go to **Settings → Cellular** and toggle off **Cellular Data** (or toggle off individual lines if you want to disable the service entirely).
- **Android**: Go to **Settings → Network & Internet → SIMs** (or **Mobile Network**) and toggle off the SIM or mobile data.
- **Airplane Mode**: On either platform, you can also enable **Airplane Mode** from the quick settings/control center to disable all wireless radios (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth), then re-enable Wi-Fi/Bluetooth individually if needed.
- **Contact your carrier**: If you want to fully suspend your cellular service/plan, you'd need to contact your carrier (e.g., Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) directly.
